components.sectionOfParticipantInstructions: ## Which district's order form you need
components.note: the manifest conditions this component on the participant filing in San Juan County, and neither fixture does. The bound binary is the Eleventh Judicial District's whole 31-page self-help packet, county-captioned as page content, dated January 28, 2022, and citing the pre-2021 statute; the track's own record carries the currency of the district packets as a release blocker. The shared host renders whole pinned binaries and this lane may not change it. Rendering it would promote a county-local, pre-amendment packet statewide, so it is not rendered, and the participant is told where the order comes from.
